title: Yonder's End
physical_identity: A floating island community under an endless void lit by colored aurora-like sky, with a spring-fed lake and mushroom crops, advertised by brochure and visited in a diary.
scale_topology: Single floating island/community; reached by a long walk with an escort; size not stated.
anomalies: staying beyond a few days becomes permanent
lighting_sound: Colored light in the sky and auroras at all times; no sound stated.

entities.name: staff with fangs, extra eyes and arms
entities.behavior: brochure says they do not bite

entities.name: Penumbras
entities.behavior: mentioned only as a prior working acquaintance

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Karl and brochure staff; no hostile entity
hazards: permanent stay after a few days

entrances.method: send letter, representative escorts on foot
entrances.quote: just send a letter to the enclosed address

exits.quote: Karl showed me the way back
anything longer than a few days is signing up for a lifetime reservation

signature_mechanic: A beautiful island that is free to enter by invitation but becomes a lifetime reservation, with visible aging, after a few days.
verticality: None; single island over a void.
do_not: turn diary despair into level hazards
conflicts_notes: Brochure and diary contrast; no entrance/exit section; the location is only 'far away across the Backrooms'. Level 898/900 links unstated.

key_quotes.quote: Built on a beautiful floating island overlooking a breath-taking view
colors dance across an endless void
the fangs are just for show
just send a letter to the enclosed address
anything longer than a few days is signing up for a lifetime reservation
